In the wide-band limit the dot Green's function is
\begin{equation}
G^r(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega-\epsilon_d+i\Gamma/2}, \qquad \Gamma \equiv 2\pi\rho_0 V^2 .
\label{eq:gr}
\end{equation}
Beyond it the rate depends on energy; for a particle-hole symmetric band it is even,
\begin{equation}
\Gamma(\omega) = \Gamma(-\omega) .
\label{eq:even}
\end{equation}
